raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "1.0" %}

# Note: as of 0.23.1, we have given up on trying to build gettext on Windows
# with MSVC -- there are new patterns that may make it simply impossible due to
# the ways that some DLL-exported variables are used. See discussion in #35. It
# *is* possible to build gettext on Windows using MinGW/GCC -- see #34. But for
# now we would rather turn off the Windows build than undertake the major
# migration that a switch to GCC would entail.
#
# The Windows build files and configuration were removed from this recipe
# in 1.0; they can be recovered from the git history if needed.

package:
  name: gettext-split
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  url: https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/gettext/gettext-{{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 71132a3fb71e68245b8f2ac4e9e97137d3e5c02f415636eb508ae607bc01add7

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - make
  host:
    - libiconv
    # With libcurl and json-c, 'spit' (used by msgpre) is built as a C program
    # instead of being installed as a Python script that needs requests.
    - libcurl
    - json-c
    # libtextstyle uses terminfo for styled output
    - ncurses


outputs:
  - name: libintl
    build:
      skip: true  # [linux]
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl') }}
      ignore_run_exports_from:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    script: install-libintl.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - libiconv
    test:
      commands:
        # Only the actual binary (versioned) variant should be in this package
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libintl.*.dylib                   # [osx]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libintl.so.*                      # [linux]
        # The unversioned variants should be in the -devel package.
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libintl$SHLIB_EXT
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/include/libintl.h                   # [osx]
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: library that provides native language support to programs

  - name: libintl-devel
    build:
      skip: true  # [linux]
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl') }}
      ignore_run_exports_from:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    script: install-libintl-devel.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - libiconv
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=true) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=true) }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libintl${SHLIB_EXT}                   # [osx]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/libintl.h                         # [osx]
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: library that provides native language support to programs

  - name: libasprintf
    build:
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        - libiconv
    script: install-asprintf.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - libiconv
    test:
      commands:
        # Only the actual binary (versioned) variant should be in this package
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libasprintf.*.dylib                   # [osx]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libasprintf.so.0                      # [linux]
        # The unversioned variants should be in the -devel package.
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libasprintf$SHLIB_EXT
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: C-style formatted output in C++

  - name: libasprintf-devel
    build:
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf') }}
      ignore_run_exports_from:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        - libiconv
    script: install-asprintf-devel.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - libiconv
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf', exact=True) }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libasprintf${SHLIB_EXT}
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: Decomposed printf argument list

  - name: libgettextpo
    build:
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo') }}
      ignore_run_exports_from:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    script: install-libgettextpo.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - libiconv
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
    test:
      commands:
        # Only the actual binary (versioned) variant should be in this package
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgettextpo.*.dylib                   # [osx]
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgettextpo.so.0                      # [linux]
        # The unversioned variants should be in the -devel package.
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgettextpo$SHLIB_EXT
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: GPL-3.0-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: library for interfacing programmatically with GNU gettext .po files

  - name: libgettextpo-devel
    build:
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo') }}
      ignore_run_exports_from:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    script: install-libgettextpo-devel.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo', exact=True) }}
        - libiconv
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo', exact=True) }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libgettextpo$SHLIB_EXT
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: GPL-3.0-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: library for interfacing programmatically with GNU gettext .po files

  - name: gettext-tools
    script: install-gettext.sh
    build:
      ignore_run_exports_from:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - libiconv
        # For the C version of 'spit'
        - libcurl
        - json-c
        # libtextstyle uses terminfo for styled output
        - ncurses
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo', exact=True ) }}
        # Devel packages are included for deduplication-purposes only
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl-devel', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf-devel', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo-devel', exact=True ) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
    test:
      files:
        - an.po
      commands:
        - gettext --version
        - ngettext --version
        - printf_gettext --version
        - printf_ngettext --version
        - envsubst --version
        - msgcmp --version
        - msgfmt --version
        - msgmerge --version
        - msgunfmt --version
        - xgettext --version
        - msgattrib --version
        - msgcat --version
        - msgcomm --version
        - msgconv --version
        - msgen --version
        - msgexec --version
        - msgfilter --version
        - msggrep --version
        - msginit --version
        - msgpre --version
        - msguniq --version
        - recode-sr-latin --version
        - autopoint --version
        - gettextize --version
        - po-fetch --version
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/bin/gettext.sh
        # 'spit' must be the C program, not the Python fallback script
        - spit --version
        - test "$(head -c 2 ${PREFIX}/bin/spit)" != "#!"
        - msgfmt -o an.gmo an.po
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      # The binaries of gettext are the GPL-3.0 licensed part.
      license: GPL-3.0-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: Internationalization package (executable tools)

  - name: gettext
    build:
      # Required to make overdepending checks pass.
      ignore_run_exports:
        - libintl
        - libasprintf
        - libgettextpo
      run_exports:
        # Seems pretty good: https://abi-laboratory.pro/tracker/timeline/gettext/
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl') }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf') }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo') }}
    script: install-gettext.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - make
      host:
        - libiconv
        - {{ pin_subpackage('gettext-tools', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl-devel', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf-devel', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo-devel', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo', exact=True ) }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('gettext-tools', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl-devel', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libintl', exact=True) }}  # [not linux]
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf-devel', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libasprintf', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo-devel', exact=True ) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('libgettextpo', exact=True ) }}
    test:
      commands:
        {% set lib_idents = [ "gettextlib", "gettextpo", "gettextsrc" ] %}
        {% set lib_idents = lib_idents + [ "intl" ] %}                         # [not linux]
        {% for lib_ident in lib_idents %}
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/lib{{ lib_ident }}$SHLIB_EXT
        - test ! -f ${PREFIX}/lib/lib{{ lib_ident }}.a
        {% endfor %}
    about:
      home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
      license: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND GPL-3.0-or-later
      license_file: COPYING
      summary: Internationalization package

about:
  home: https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Internationalization package

extra:
  feedstock-name: gettext
  recipe-maintainers:
    - scopatz
    - ocefpaf
    - pkgw
    - xhochy
